crm_notes: Mid-market SaaS (customer success/productivity). Team is pragmatic: tried Hosted API first to validate quality, now wants Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC controls. poc_scope: 6-week Dedicated POC: reserved GPU pool + VPC peering
Canary rollout: 10% traffic to Dedicated for week 1, 50% week 2, 100% week 3 if metrics green
Fallback routing: primary->dedicated, fallback->hosted_api model variant with identical tokenization
Model variants: quantized 8-bit for cost trial, higher-precision variant for quality check
Region failover plan: primary US-west, secondary US-east; automated DNS + session continuity via KV cache replication
Rollback plan: immediate traffic diversion to hosted_api + freeze on model rollouts; SE-run planbook with steps and runbook links

Embedding throughput 200 reqs/sec with median latency <150ms
No data egress incidents; audit logs captured and pulled into customer's SIEM
Cost per 10k tokens within agreed ARR band during steady-state
